notes: V18.13: Vipimo vya tape (ditch to ditch / gravel) vinatumika moja kwa moja kwenye cross sections na typical sections (TAPE). Sehemu za lami (DSD/SSD/AC) zinatambuliwa na kuchorwa kama paved. Mitaro: zege trapezoidal na grouted stone pitching + concrete invert (siyo masonry). Patch works za lami kila hatua item yake: 2.13a kuandaa shimo, 2.13d C1 / 2.13f C2, 2.14a priming, 2.15b AC au 2.17a/2.17b seals; rehab na reseal pia.
